items.text: Develop and maintain SSD controller firmware on embedded platforms.
Develop and maintain SSD controller SDK for new IC platforms, including boot flow, driver layer, and HAL.
Develop and validate firmware on FPGA platforms for pre-silicon verification.
Support silicon bring-up and perform HW/SW integration and debugging.
Perform root cause analysis and debug issues related to memory corruption, data mismatch, and system behavior.

description.text:
1. Familiar NAND Flash firmware.
2. SSD White-box Test.
3. Develop and maintain SSD controller firmware on embedded platforms.
4. Develop and maintain SSD controller SDK for new IC platforms, including boot flow, driver layer, and HAL.
5. Develop and validate firmware on FPGA platforms for pre-silicon verification.
6. Support silicon bring-up and perform HW/SW integration and debugging.
7. Perform root cause analysis and debug issues related to memory corruption, data mismatch, and system behavior.

key_values.text:
